raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "represent"
      role subject ?l
      role object "the Okafor family"
      role location "Lagos"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "draft"
      role subject ?l
      role object ?lease
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "sign"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?lease
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
